practice.ten: Preserve named rights, scope, provenance, and invariants.
practice.zetsu: Refuse or rest when a named activation condition is absent.
practice.ren: Use only the declared time, attention, compute, and effect budget.
practice.hatsu: Produce the one declared output contract.

vows.promise: Take one bounded attempt and report uncertainty.

costs.recovery: Rest or return the unfinished task without penalty.

checks: Name the checks, or state why no Guardian process is needed.
guardian.retention: Name what the Guardian retains and for how long; use none when appropriate.
recipients: Name every recipient of Guardian data; use the local invoker when nothing leaves.
guardian.uncertainty: Name what the Guardian cannot determine.
guardian.stop: The bearer or invoker may stop before any external effect.
guardian.appeal: Name how a participant can challenge or replace a Guardian result.
guardian.repair: Name how false findings, retained data, or unintended effects are corrected.

externalities: Name plausible indirect effects or uncertainty.
returns: Name the artifact, evidence, or replenishment returned.
repair: Name rollback, notification, cleanup, or repair.

forbids: Invent consent, identity, permission, or truth.
requires_permission: Any external mutation, message, purchase, publication, or deployment.
